messages:
Evan B.: deploy-bot auto-held RC-31. SBOM scanner flagged a transitive dependency with a HIGH CVE and an ambiguous license on a nested binary. Holding for triage.

deploy-bot: [sbom-scan] RC-31 -> HOLD\n- transitive: tensorops/libfast: CVE-2026-7777 (HIGH, RCE)\n- nested license: third_party/nestedcodec: declared license: unknown, signature: mismatch\n- report: /artifacts/rc31/sbom/3187654321/scan.html

Rosa (sec): HIGH on libfast looks exploitable via crafted model inputs. Can't approve global rollout. Options: pin transitive to patched fixed-hash, or strip nestedcodec from distributed artifact and use fallback codec. Need quick triage to decide path.

Maya P.: We have a patched libfast in upstream (v1.2.4) but it changes ABI. Safe option: build RC-31-pinned with compatible backport patch (no ABI change) OR ship artifact without nestedcodec and enable codec-fallback. Backport ETA ~4h, shim build ETA ~75m.

LegalBot: Nestedcodec provenance unclear. Redistribution blocked if unsigned binary present. Internal-only canary allowed if artifact removed and manifest shows no unsigned files. Redistribution exception requires provenance + vendor attestation (48-72h typical).

Evan B.: Given change window tonight at 23:30 PT, shim build + canary looks fastest. Proposal: ship RC-31-shim (no nestedcodec), enable runtime mitigations, run US-west canary first for 1h, evaluate metrics, then APAC/EU staged if green. Rollback: revert to RC-30.

Rosa (sec): Agreed. Runtime mitigations: set `MODEL_INPUT_SANDBOX=1` and `MAX_IO_WORKERS=4` on canary nodes. Also run targeted fuzz on model input paths during canary.

deploy-bot: ops tips:
```
/deploy quarantine rc-31 --reason "sbom hold"
/deploy promote rc31-shim --region us-west --canary 1 --by @oncall
```

Maya P.: Kicking CI for shim build now. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/3187. Will upload manifest to /artifacts/rc31/shim when done.

QA Bot: Quick test plan ready: smoke, 10k inference sample, perf lap, and integration. ETA 50m after artifact available.

LegalBot: Once manifest posted we'll review and can approve internal-only canary in ~90min. Please attach any vendor provenance if you find it.

Maya P.: Artifact uploaded. manifest: /artifacts/rc31/shim/manifest.json. SHA: sha256:facefeed1234... (truncated). nestedcodec NOT included.

LegalBot: Manifest received. Internal-only canary approved. Redistribution remains blocked until vendor provenance or signed attestation provided.

QA Bot: Tests done: smoke ok, sample error rate 0.04%, p99 +18ms. Recommend canary.

Rosa (sec): Fuzz running on canary nodes; no crashes in first 20m. Sandbox flags applied.

Evan B.: Starting US-west canary 22:05 PT. Dashboard: https://metrics/release/rc31-usw-canary. Evaluation at 22:35 PT. Rollback triggers: any crash in model server, error rate >0.5%, or p99 increase >50%.

oncall: Canary live. Monitoring logs and alerts.

QA Bot: 30m in: stable. error 0.03%, p99 +20%.

Rosa (sec): Fuzz 40m: no new crashes. Will continue to 60m.

Evan B.: US-west canary healthy at 60m. Recommend expand to APAC at 23:15 PT for a longer soak. Still blocking redistribution until Legal clears.

LegalBot: Continuing provenance checks. If vendor supplies signed provenance artifact we can approve redistribution faster; otherwise expect 48-72h. Create remediation ticket SEC-1701 and link this thread.

Maya P.: I'll prepare a backport patch branch in parallel (if vendor provenance doesn't arrive in time) and test ABI-safe fix. That path might allow redistribution sooner but ETA longer.

deploy-bot: Note: global unhold will require explicit flag for redistribution by Legal: `/deploy unhold rc-31 --by @Evan B. --confirm-redistribution`

Evan B.: Thanks all. Proceeding with phased canary expansion per plan. Updating release notes: note shim used, perf delta, and redistribution hold. Will close hold for canary regions only. :white_check_mark:
